clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
Executive Orber
Samuel R. Brame, Deputy Collector of Internal Revenue in the
Sixth Internal Revenue District of Virginia, may be given a competitive
classified status, in order that he may be transferred to a classified position
in the field service, without compliance with civil service rules.
WOODROW WILSON
TILE W1!ViiiitHOUSE,
October 12, 1915.
[No. 2254.1
